heading: How Jayden Daniels’ mom supported his football ambitions before the Commanders made him the star QB
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 07:39 IST
paragraphs: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was carted off the field Sunday against the Dallas Cowboys after dislocating his left elbow on the final play of the first half, the same elbow he injured last November against Seattle
Commanders head coach Dan Quinn confirmed it was a left elbow dislocation with no fracture, with more imaging scheduled later this week
Daniels was in the middle of one of his sharper performances this season before the play fell apart

Now, as Washington falls to 0-2, attention turns back to the man behind the jersey and the woman who made sure he got there.How did Jayden Daniels' mom shape his path to the NFL?Jayden Daniels' parents, Regina Jackson and Javon Daniels, met while both were students at Cajon High School in California, the same school their son would later attend

Javon is a big reason Jayden got into the sport at all. "When he was born, when he was old enough to walk, you hand him a ball, and I said, 'this is what you're gonna do,'" Javon said at the Heisman Trophy ceremony.But it was Regina who kept the engine running. "My mother has never missed a game," Daniels said on "The Pivot" podcast. "If it's raining out there, she's going to be out there
If it's minus degrees, she's going to be out there standing up the whole time making sure she's cheering me on." That is not hyperbole
From Arizona State to LSU to the NFL Draft, Regina Jackson showed up

Every single time."The word perseverance is that kid Jayden," she said before the Heisman Trophy ceremony. "The patience he has, the resilience to continue day after day, hour after hour, minute after minute, to be the best version of himself — just watching him get up at 5:30 in the morning to be great is really hard to describe."Daniels has been equally open about how much she means to him off the field too. "Nothing gets past my mama," he said. "She reads people and doesn't put people around me that don't benefit me
My mom's support through this journey has been huge."Why did Jayden Daniels' mom become a certified NFL agent?Regina Jackson did not stop at being a fan in the stands
She became an NFLPA-certified agent after passing the exam administered in late July 2024, making her likely the first parent of a top-three draft pick in NFL history to earn that designation
She holds an MBA with a concentration in entrepreneurship and a master's degree in public service administration
This was not a vanity project."Role number one, she plays my mom
From there, she's my business manager, and then also she is a certified NFL agent," Daniels said
As of March 2026, she became his only listed agent after he parted ways with Agency 1 Sports Group

With a contract extension on the horizon, her role has never mattered more.When Daniels suffered a hamstring injury and fans started drawing comparisons to Robert Griffin III, Jackson quickly shut it down on social media: "I wish you would stop manifesting RGIII on my son

Words are powerful and that's all that's talked about." She protects the narrative as fiercely as she protects his circle.Now, as Daniels heads into another injury scare with Washington needing answers fast, his mother is again at the center of the storm
